globalSettings.title: Global Settings
globalSettings.decimalSeparatorDesc: Defines how decimal values are typed in admin forms (including currency amount format).
globalSettings.pythonPathDesc: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used by the code interpreter tool. Leave empty to auto-detect from known system locations.
globalSettings.llmSettingsDesc: Language model instance and cache configuration for reports, insights, and emails.
globalSettings.defaultLlmDesc: LLM instance used for AI suggestions across all screens (e.g., log analysis, monitoring summaries).
globalSettings.defaultAiAgentDesc: AI Agent used by default in chat experiences when no agent is explicitly selected.
globalSettings.llmCacheDesc: Enable caching of LLM responses for reports, insights, and emails to reduce API calls and improve response time.
globalSettings.cacheDurationDesc: How long cached LLM responses remain valid before a new request is made.
globalSettings.regenerateCacheDesc: Force a new LLM call on the next request, ignoring any existing cache. The cache will be recreated with the fresh response.
globalSettings.ragSettingsDesc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for asset indexing and knowledge base.
globalSettings.enableRagDesc: Enables automatic embedding indexing of files stored in Assets (MinIO). Requires an Embedding Model and Store to be configured below.
globalSettings.embeddingModelRequired: Embedding Model is required when RAG is enabled
globalSettings.defaultEmbeddingModelDesc: Model used to generate vector embeddings for asset content.
globalSettings.embeddingStoreRequired: Embedding Store is required when RAG is enabled
globalSettings.defaultEmbeddingStoreDesc: Vector database where asset embeddings are stored and queried.
globalSettings.emailSettingsDesc: Configure email service for notifications and weekly reports.
globalSettings.emailProviderDesc: Service used to send transactional emails.
globalSettings.apiKeyDesc: API key for the selected email provider.
globalSettings.senderEmailDesc: Email address used as the sender for outgoing emails.
globalSettings.senderNameDesc: Display name shown as the sender (e.g., "Viglet Turing").
globalSettings.recipientEmailDesc: Default recipient for automated reports (e.g., weekly search report).
globalSettings.testEmailHint: Save settings before testing to use the latest configuration.
globalSettings.loadFailed: Failed to load global settings. Using default values.
globalSettings.testEmailFailed: Failed to send test email. Check your email settings.
